training_source: CREMA-D, ESD, MELD, M3ED and Singaporean speech
notes: Each clip becomes Whisper log-mel features padded with silence to 30 s (as in the model card); the model ignores attention masks and pools over the whole 30 s window, padding included, which is its official behaviour. float32 on every device, as released.

columns.audio_path: audio file, relative to the emotion_recognition/ folder
columns.acted_emotion: ground truth: the emotion each actor was asked to portray, from the letters after the speaker in the file name (`a`nger, `d`isgust, `f`ear, `h`appiness, `n`eutral, `sa`dness, `su`rprise)
columns.prediction: model prediction: the most probable of the 7 emotions evaluated (angry, disgusted, fearful, happy, neutral, sad, surprised)
columns.prediction_all_classes: model prediction: the most probable of all 7 model classes
columns.p_*: model probability of each of its 7 classes (they add up to 1)
